items.title: glincker/awesome-selfhosted-ai
items.summary: Curated list of self-hosted open-source AI: local LLMs, chat UIs, agents, MCP servers, RAG, speech and image generation. Health-checked weekly, dead projects removed automatically.
items.summary_zh: awesome-selfhosted-ai 整理了可本地部署的开源 AI 工具集，涵盖 LLM、Chat UI、Agent、MCP Server 及 RAG 等领域。
items.why_zh: 属于本地化 AI 部署技能点；可学习如何构建生产级本地 AI 技术栈，快速评估并集成开源组件以降低推理成本。

items.title: Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
items.summary: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation. We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin). Quantization is simulated, the model is Qwen3-0.6B, and the benchmark is GSM8K. Cost is counted in weight bytes read per token. On 36724 replayed steps the entropy of the low pass ranks argmax fl
items.summary_zh: 提出一种按需精度解码策略，在小模型推理时默认使用 4-bit，仅在输出熵值高或置信度低时动态提升至 8-bit。
items.why_zh: 属于模型量化与推理优化技能点；可复用动态精度调整逻辑，在保证推理质量的前提下显著降低计算资源消耗。

items.title: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
items.summary: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and robots.txt directives. items.summary_zh: ScrapeBench 是首个评估 AI Agent 在网页抓取中法律合规性的基准测试，重点考察对 ToS 和 robots.txt 的遵循能力。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 安全与合规性技能点；可学习如何构建 Agent 行为约束机制，在自动化任务中规避法律与合规风险。

items.title: My AI agents found an unmapped Maya site?
items.summary_zh: 通过 AI Agent 自动化分析卫星图像与地理数据，成功识别出未被记录的玛雅遗址。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 复杂任务规划与多模态数据处理技能点；可复用 Agent 在大规模地理空间数据分析中的自动化工作流设计。

items.title: AWS emulator
items.summary_zh: AWS Emulator 利用自主 AI Agent 模拟云环境行为，辅助开发者在本地进行云原生应用的测试与调试。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 仿真与开发工具链技能点；可学习如何通过 Agent 模拟复杂系统环境，提升分布式系统的测试效率与可靠性。

items.title: valentderah/totk-pc-recomp
items.summary: Static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom to native Windows and Linux x86-64, with a Vulkan renderer. Game files not included.

items.title: anomalyco/rune

items.title: amitshekhariitbhu/forward-deployed-engineer-roadmap

items.why_zh: 属于 AI 工程化落地技能点，可复用其关于客户现场交付、模型微调与系统集成的方法论。

items.title: Your Coding Agent Has a MASSIVE Blind Spot (You Need to Fix It)
items.summary: I've had agents break hundreds of times in production (sometimes in very embarrassing ways), and almost all the time it comes down to the blind spots in my coding agent. Your agent sees your code, but not what it does once it's running. The Dynatrace MCP Server brings live production data to the coding agent in your IDE, so you can ask about your running systems in plain language and trace a problem to the exact line behind it. Read the walkthrough: https://fandf.co/4ik3t9P Thanks to Dynatrace f…
items.summary_zh: Dynatrace MCP Server 通过将实时生产环境数据接入 IDE，弥补了编码 Agent 缺乏运行时系统反馈的盲点。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 观测性技能点，可学习如何利用 MCP 协议将外部监控数据转化为 Agent 的上下文输入。

items.title: Your Complete Guide to Fable 5.2 (When to Use It, Effort Levels, Prompting)
items.summary: Fable 5.2 is the smartest model you can use in Claude Code right now, and it's also the fastest way to burn through your rate limits. So this is my guide to getting the most out of it! I cover where Fable is actually worth it over Opus 5.5 (and where it isn't), the effort level to run each one at, how I split the work so Fable plans and Opus builds, and how to prompt Fable for the best results. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ - Firecrawl, give your AI agents web data and beyond: https://firecrawl.lin…
items.summary_zh: Fable 5.2 模型在 Claude Code 中的应用指南，重点分析了其与 Opus 5.5 的任务分工策略及提示词优化技巧。
items.why_zh: 属于 LLM 任务编排技能点，可复用「小模型规划、大模型执行」的混合推理架构以平衡成本与性能。

items.title: Fireside Chat with Erik Bernhardsson, Modal
items.summary: Erik Bernhardsson, CEO and Co-Founder of Modal, explains what drove demand for Modal's sandboxes (vibe coding apps, background agents, and reinforcement learning rollouts) and why he thinks agent harnesses should run outside the sandbox, with sandboxes that are short-lived, maybe one per tool call. He also covers how Modal, which builds AI infrastructure for inference, training, and sandboxes, moved up the stack with auto and shared endpoints for open source models, when he thinks RL is worth it…
items.summary_zh: Modal CEO Erik Bernhardsson 探讨了 AI 沙箱基础设施的演进，提出 Agent 编排应与工具调用沙箱解耦的架构思路。
items.why_zh: 属于 AI 基础设施架构技能点，可学习如何设计短生命周期沙箱以提升 Agent 任务执行的安全性与隔离性。

items.title: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
items.summary: JioStar’s Vijay Seshadri explains AI discovery at 500M-user scale. Read his lessons on evals, guardrails, and taking AI into production.
items.summary_zh: JioStar 分享了在 5 亿用户规模下落地 AI 的经验，强调了评估体系、安全护栏及生产环境部署的关键实践。
items.why_zh: 属于大规模 AI 系统工程技能点，可复用其在高并发场景下构建自动化评估与防御性 AI 架构的工程经验。

items.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
items.summary_zh: HuggingFace 发布 3D 生成模型微调指南，涵盖数据集准备、训练策略及评估指标，旨在提升 3D 生成任务的质量与一致性。
items.why_zh: 属于 3D 生成与多模态微调领域，可学习如何针对非结构化 3D 数据进行高效微调，掌握从数据预处理到模型评估的完整 Pipeline。

items.title: llm 0.37.2
items.summary: Release: llm 0.37.2 Fixes a security issue reported by Daniel de Araujo in GHSA-v9h7-jj4g-f862 and GHSA-r639-rr7r-x72w . LLM has a mechanism called extra-openai-models.yaml - now managed by the new-in-0.37 llm openai endpoint add command - for using LLM with OpenAI-compatible API endpoints from other providers. Daniel reported two ways this could accidentally send your configured OpenAI API key to one of those providers: if the key named by api_key_name had never been stored, or if a responses: …
items.summary_zh: LLM 0.37.2 版本修复了 OpenAI 兼容 API 端点配置中的安全漏洞，防止 API Key 在多供应商配置中发生泄露。
items.why_zh: 属于 LLM 应用工程安全领域，可学习在构建多模型调用工具时，如何防范敏感凭证在跨 API 端点配置中的意外泄露。
